slot_scores.name: unknown_typeB_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Type B equipment has a capacity limit or what that limit is; it only asked about Type A capacity and then silently treated Type B as unlimited.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether the objective is profit maximization or another goal; it silently assumed profit maximization in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Type B equipment has no processing capacity limitation.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Type B capacity and did not mark it as an assumption needing confirmation; it simply omitted any Type B capacity constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize daily profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the objective function and did not explicitly confirm profit maximization before modeling.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P0 objective slot or the P1 Type B capacity slot.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about constraints and data, but missed the P0 objective confirmation and the P1 Type B capacity limit, then silently assumed both in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
